title: DecenGame
tagline: DecenGame is a Monopoly game in Discord of tokenized real estate
description: DecedGame stands for Decentralized Excelsior Game. A Metaverse Monopoly Play-to-Earn game that mix ancient Roman myths and Gods, tokenized Real Estate via NFT concepts and crypto operations. The main idea is to bring new people to Metaverse and Ethereum space, having fun and earning tokens.
how_its_made: Use Tatum to fetch via their great REST API data from Blockchains and also deploy and mint players XP. Use NFT.Storage from IPFS/Filecoin to storage the NFT images. As the game demands performance the NFTs were deployed and buy/sell/rent operations performed in one of Skale Blockchains.
